regression.baseline_result: Expected failure: the same version and Node with a different installation digest did not raise CoreError.
regression.fixed_result: The same version with an unknown installation digest returns CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED before checking Node or locating the hosted launcher. The reviewed digest still resolves the packaged launcher.

native_windows_connector_loopback.scenario: Connector Pi editor reviewed interrupt with a real Pi 0.87.1 process

limitations: The negative regression uses a controlled candidate identity. The native process probe uses the exact reviewed Pi installation and an isolated in-process model fixture.

The local probe covers editor queue, detach and reattach with installed wheels. The Connector interrupt probe used loopback on the same Windows host. Both use disposable profiles and synthetic responses.
The installed Nexus suite skipped the 14 browser tests gated by OKTO_NEXUS_UI_CAMPAIGN. Its Starlette and WebSocket dependencies reported deprecation warnings.
The full I06 scenario and SI-027 qualification remain open. The matrix links earlier evidence at its original scope.
rollback: Revert the Nexus and Connector vendored wheels, then revert the Core check together with its regression.
